texts.ezk.11.18: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
texts.ezk.11.19: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh;
texts.ezk.11.20: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
texts.ezk.11.21: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.11.22: Then did the cherubim lift up their wings, and the wheels were beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
texts.ezk.11.23: And the glory of Jehovah went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
texts.ezk.11.24: And the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
texts.ezk.11.25: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Jehovah had showed me.
texts.ezk.12.1: The word of Jehovah also came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.12.2: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of the rebellious house, that have eyes to see, and see not, that have ears to hear, and hear not; for they are a rebellious house.
texts.ezk.12.3: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.
texts.ezk.12.4: And thou shalt bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing; and thou shalt go forth thyself at even in their sight, as when men go forth into exile.
texts.ezk.12.5: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
texts.ezk.12.6: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulder, and carry it forth in the dark; thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the land: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
texts.ezk.12.7: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for removing, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I brought it forth in the dark, and bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
texts.ezk.12.8: And in the morning came the word of Jehovah unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.12.9: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
texts.ezk.12.10: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This burden [concerneth] the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.
texts.ezk.12.11: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them; they shall go into exile, into captivity.
texts.ezk.12.12: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the dark, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, because he shall not see the land with his eyes.
texts.ezk.12.13: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
texts.ezk.12.14: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are round about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
texts.ezk.12.15: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall disperse them among the nations, and scatter them through the countries.
texts.ezk.12.16: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the nations whither they come; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.12.17: Moreover the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,
texts.ezk.12.18: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with fearfulness;
texts.ezk.12.19: and say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with fearfulness, and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, [and despoiled] of all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
texts.ezk.12.20: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be a desolation; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.12.21: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.12.22: Son of man, what is this proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
texts.ezk.12.23: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the fulfilment of every vision.
texts.ezk.12.24: For there shall be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
texts.ezk.12.25: For I am Jehovah; I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be performed; it shall be no more deferred: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I speak the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.12.26: Again the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,
texts.ezk.12.27: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many day to come, and he prophesieth of times that are far off.
texts.ezk.12.28: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: There shall none of my words be deferred any more, but the word which I shall speak shall be performed, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.13.1: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.13.2: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own heart, Hear ye the word of Jehovah:
texts.ezk.13.3: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
texts.ezk.13.4: O Israel, thy prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.
texts.ezk.13.5: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the day of Jehovah.
texts.ezk.13.6: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, that say, Jehovah saith; but Jehovah hath not sent them: and they have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.
texts.ezk.13.7: Have ye not seen a false vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, in that ye say, Jehovah saith; albeit I have not spoken?
texts.ezk.13.8: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have spoken falsehood, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.13.9: And my hand shall be against the prophets that see false visions, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the council of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.13.10: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there is no peace; and when one buildeth up a wall, behold, they daub it with untempered [mortar]:
texts.ezk.13.11: say unto them that daub it with untempered [mortar], that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
texts.ezk.13.12: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
texts.ezk.13.13: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my wrath; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.
texts.ezk.13.14: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered [mortar], and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be uncovered; and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.13.15: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered [mortar]; and I will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
texts.ezk.13.16: [to wit], the prophets of Israel that prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and that see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.13.17: And thou, son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, that prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
texts.ezk.13.18: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the women that sew pillows upon all elbows, and make kerchiefs for the head of [persons of] every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and save souls alive for yourselves?
texts.ezk.13.19: And ye have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hearken unto lies.
texts.ezk.13.20: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make [them] fly, and I will tear them from your arms; and I will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make [them] fly.
texts.ezk.13.21: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.13.22: Because with lies ye have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive:
texts.ezk.13.23: Therefore ye shall no more see false visions, nor divine divinations: and I will deliver my people out of your hand; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.14.1: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
texts.ezk.14.2: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.14.3: Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be inquired of at all by them?
texts.ezk.14.4: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Every man of the house of Israel that taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I Jehovah will answer him therein according to the multitude of his idols;
texts.ezk.14.5: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
texts.ezk.14.6: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Return ye, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
texts.ezk.14.7: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that separateth himself from me, and taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet to inquire for himself of me; I Jehovah will answer him by myself:
texts.ezk.14.8: and I will set my face against that man, and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.14.9: And if the prophet be deceived and speak a word, I, Jehovah, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
texts.ezk.14.10: And they shall bear their iniquity: the iniquity of the prophet shall be even as the iniquity of him that seeketh [unto him];
texts.ezk.14.11: that the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.14.12: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.14.13: Son of man, when a land sinneth against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand upon it, and break the staff of the bread thereof, and send famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast;
texts.ezk.14.14: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.14.15: If I cause evil beasts to pass through the land, and they ravage it, and it be made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the beasts;
texts.ezk.14.16: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only should be delivered, but the land should be desolate.
texts.ezk.14.17: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off from it man and beast;
texts.ezk.14.18: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only should be delivered themselves.
texts.ezk.14.19: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast;
texts.ezk.14.20: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, they should deliver neither son nor daughter; they should but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
texts.ezk.14.21: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the evil beasts, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast!
texts.ezk.14.22: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be carried forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings; and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
texts.ezk.14.23: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their way and their doings; and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.15.1: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.15.2: Son of man, what is the vine-tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?
texts.ezk.15.3: Shall wood be taken thereof to make any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
texts.ezk.15.4: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire hath devoured both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned: is it profitable for any work?
texts.ezk.15.5: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned, shall it yet be meet for any work!
texts.ezk.15.6: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As the vine-tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
texts.ezk.15.7: And I will set my face against them; they shall go forth from the fire, but the fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I set my face against them.
texts.ezk.15.8: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.16.1: Again the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.16.2: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;
texts.ezk.16.3: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto Jerusalem: Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of the Canaanite; the Amorite was thy father, and thy mother was a Hittite.
texts.ezk.16.4: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to cleanse thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
texts.ezk.16.5: No eye pitied thee, to do any of these things unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, for that thy person was abhorred, in the day that thou wast born.
texts.ezk.16.6: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee weltering in thy blood, I said unto thee, [Though thou art] in thy blood, live; yea, I said unto thee, [Though thou art] in thy blood, live.
texts.ezk.16.7: I caused thee to multiply as that which groweth in the field, and thou didst increase and wax great, and thou attainedst to excellent ornament; thy breasts were fashioned, and thy hair was grown; yet thou wast naked and bare.
texts.ezk.16.8: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord Jehovah, and thou becamest mine.
texts.ezk.16.9: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
texts.ezk.16.10: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with sealskin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and covered thee with silk.
texts.ezk.16.11: And I decked thee with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
texts.ezk.16.12: And I put a ring upon thy nose, and ear-rings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thy head.
texts.ezk.16.13: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil; and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper unto royal estate.
texts.ezk.16.14: And thy renown went forth among the nations for thy beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.16.15: But thou didst trust in thy beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy whoredoms on every one that passed by; his it was.
texts.ezk.16.16: And thou didst take of thy garments, and madest for thee high places decked with divers colors, and playedst the harlot upon them: [the like things] shall not come, neither shall it be [so].
texts.ezk.16.17: Thou didst also take thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest for thee images of men, and didst play the harlot with them;
texts.ezk.16.18: and thou tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them, and didst set mine oil and mine incense before them.
texts.ezk.16.19: My bread also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou didst even set it before them for a sweet savor; and [thus] it was, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.16.20: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Were thy whoredoms a small matter,
texts.ezk.16.21: that thou hast slain my children, and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through [the fire] unto them?
texts.ezk.16.22: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast weltering in thy blood.
texts.ezk.16.23: And it is come to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord Jehovah,)
texts.ezk.16.24: that thou hast built unto thee a vaulted place, and hast made thee a lofty place in every street.
texts.ezk.16.25: Thou hast built thy lofty place at the head of every way, and hast made thy beauty an abomination, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredom.
texts.ezk.16.26: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians, thy neighbors, great of flesh; and hast multiplied thy whoredom, to provoke me to anger.
texts.ezk.16.27: Behold therefore, I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary [food], and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, that are ashamed of thy lewd way.
texts.ezk.16.28: Thou hast played the harlot also with the Assyrians, because thou wast insatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet thou wast not satisfied.
texts.ezk.16.29: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy whoredom unto the land of traffic, unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
texts.ezk.16.30: How weak is thy heart, saith the Lord Jehovah, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an impudent harlot;
texts.ezk.16.31: in that thou buildest thy vaulted place at the head of every way, and makest thy lofty place in every street, and hast not been as a harlot, in that thou scornest hire.
texts.ezk.16.32: A wife that committeth adultery! that taketh strangers instead of her husband!
texts.ezk.16.33: They give gifts to all harlots; but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and bribest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredoms.
texts.ezk.16.34: And thou art different from [other] women in thy whoredoms, in that none followeth thee to play the harlot; and whereas thou givest hire, and no hire is given unto thee, therefore thou art different.
texts.ezk.16.35: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of Jehovah:
texts.ezk.16.36: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness uncovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers; and because of all the idols of thy abominations, and for the blood of thy children, that thou didst give unto them;
texts.ezk.16.37: therefore behold, I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them against thee on every side, and will uncover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
texts.ezk.16.38: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring upon thee the blood of wrath and jealousy.
texts.ezk.16.39: I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thy vaulted place, and break down thy lofty places; and they shall strip thee of thy clothes, and take thy fair jewels; and they shall leave thee naked and bare.
texts.ezk.16.40: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
texts.ezk.16.41: And they shall burn thy houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women; and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou shalt also give no hire any more.
texts.ezk.16.42: So will I cause my wrath toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
texts.ezk.16.43: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring thy way upon thy head, saith the Lord Jehovah: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness with all thine abominations.
texts.ezk.16.44: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use [this] proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
texts.ezk.16.45: Thou art the daughter of thy mother, that loatheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children: your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
texts.ezk.16.46: And thine elder sister is Samaria, that dwelleth at thy left hand, she and her daughters; and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
texts.ezk.16.47: Yet hast thou not walked in their ways, nor done after their abominations; but, as [if that were] a very little [thing], thou wast more corrupt than they in all thy ways.
texts.ezk.16.48: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
texts.ezk.16.49: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom: pride, fulness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
texts.ezk.16.50: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw [good].
texts.ezk.16.51: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters by all thine abominations which thou hast done.
texts.ezk.16.52: Thou also, bear thou thine own shame, in that thou hast given judgment for thy sisters; through thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous that thou: yea, be thou also confounded, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
texts.ezk.16.53: And I will turn again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them;
texts.ezk.16.54: that thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be ashamed because of all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
texts.ezk.16.55: And thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate; and thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
texts.ezk.16.56: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
texts.ezk.16.57: before thy wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, that do despite unto thee round about.
texts.ezk.16.58: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith Jehovah.
texts.ezk.16.59: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also deal with thee as thou hast done, who hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
texts.ezk.16.60: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
texts.ezk.16.61: Then shalt thou remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder [sisters] and thy younger; and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
texts.ezk.16.62: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah;
texts.ezk.16.63: that thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more, because of thy shame, when I have forgiven thee all that thou hast done, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.17.1: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.17.2: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
texts.ezk.17.3: and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A great eagle with great wings and long pinions, full of feathers, which had divers colors, came unto Lebanon, and took the top of the cedar:
texts.ezk.17.4: he cropped off the topmost of the young twigs thereof, and carried it unto a land of traffic; he set it in a city of merchants.
texts.ezk.17.5: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful soil; he placed it beside many waters; he set it as a willow-tree.
texts.ezk.17.6: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
texts.ezk.17.7: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend its roots toward him, and shot forth its branches toward him, from the beds of its plantation, that he might water it.
texts.ezk.17.8: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
texts.ezk.17.9: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it may wither; that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? and not by a strong arm or much people can it be raised from the roots thereof.
texts.ezk.17.10: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the beds where it grew.
texts.ezk.17.11: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.17.12: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and brought them to him to Babylon:
texts.ezk.17.13: and he took of the seed royal, and made a covenant with him; he also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land;
texts.ezk.17.14: that the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
texts.ezk.17.15: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? shall he break the covenant, and yet escape?
texts.ezk.17.16: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
texts.ezk.17.17: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts, to cut off many persons.
texts.ezk.17.18: For he hath despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet hath done all these things; he shall not escape.
texts.ezk.17.19: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, I will even bring it upon his own head.
texts.ezk.17.20: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
texts.ezk.17.21: And all his fugitives in all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward every wind: and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
texts.ezk.17.22: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also take of the lofty top of the cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it upon a high and lofty mountain:
texts.ezk.17.23: in the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it; and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all birds of every wing; in the shade of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
texts.ezk.17.24: And all the trees of the field shall know that I, Jehovah, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish; I, Jehovah, have spoken and have done it.
texts.ezk.18.1: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,
texts.ezk.18.2: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
texts.ezk.18.3: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, ye shall not have [occasion] any more to use this proverb in Israel.
texts.ezk.18.4: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
texts.ezk.18.5: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
texts.ezk.18.6: and hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbor's wife, neither hath come near to a woman in her impurity,
texts.ezk.18.7: and hath not wronged any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath taken nought by robbery, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
texts.ezk.18.8: he that hath not given forth upon interest, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true justice between man and man,
texts.ezk.18.9: hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept mine ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.18.10: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth any one of these things,
texts.ezk.18.11: and that doeth not any of those [duties], but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbor's wife,
texts.ezk.18.12: hath wronged the poor and needy, hath taken by robbery, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
texts.ezk.18.13: hath given forth upon interest, and hath taken increase; shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
texts.ezk.18.14: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins, which he hath done, and feareth, and doeth not such like;
texts.ezk.18.15: that hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbor's wife,
texts.ezk.18.16: neither hath wronged any, hath not taken aught to pledge, neither hath taken by robbery, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
texts.ezk.18.17: that hath withdrawn his hand from the poor, that hath not received interest nor increase, hath executed mine ordinances, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
texts.ezk.18.18: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he shall die in his iniquity.
texts.ezk.18.19: Yet say ye, Wherefore doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? when the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
texts.ezk.18.20: The soul that sinneth, it shall die: the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
texts.ezk.18.21: But if the wicked turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
texts.ezk.18.22: None of his transgressions that he hath committed shall be remembered against him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
texts.ezk.18.23: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked? saith the Lord Jehovah; and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
texts.ezk.18.24: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? None of his righteous deeds that he hath done shall be remembered: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
texts.ezk.18.25: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel: Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
texts.ezk.18.26: When the righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth therein; in his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
texts.ezk.18.27: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
texts.ezk.18.28: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
texts.ezk.18.29: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
texts.ezk.18.30: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord Jehovah. Return ye, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
texts.ezk.18.31: Cast away from you all your transgressions, wherein ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
texts.ezk.18.32: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord Jehovah: wherefore turn yourselves, and live.
texts.ezk.19.1: Moreover, take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
texts.ezk.19.2: and say, What was thy mother? A lioness: she couched among lions, in the midst of the young lions she nourished her whelps.
texts.ezk.19.3: And she brought up one of her whelps: he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.
texts.ezk.19.4: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks unto the land of Egypt.
texts.ezk.19.5: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
texts.ezk.19.6: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.
texts.ezk.19.7: And he knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, because of the noise of his roaring.
texts.ezk.19.8: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces; and they spread their net over him; he was taken in their pit.
texts.ezk.19.9: And they put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into strongholds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
texts.ezk.19.10: Thy mother was like a vine, in thy blood, planted by the waters: it was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
texts.ezk.19.11: And it had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and their stature was exalted among the thick boughs, and they were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.
texts.ezk.19.12: But it was plucked up in fury, it was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit: its strong rods were broken off and withered; the fire consumed them.
texts.ezk.19.13: And now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
texts.ezk.19.14: And fire is gone out of the rods of its branches, it hath devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
texts.ezk.20.1: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], the tenth [day] of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Jehovah, and sat before me.
texts.ezk.20.2: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.20.3: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Is it to inquire of me that ye are come? As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.
texts.ezk.20.4: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers;
texts.ezk.20.5: and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the day when I chose Israel, and sware unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I sware unto them, saying, I am Jehovah your God;
texts.ezk.20.6: in that day I sware unto them, to bring them forth out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.
texts.ezk.20.7: And I said unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am Jehovah your God.
texts.ezk.20.8: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me; they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
texts.ezk.20.9: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
texts.ezk.20.10: So I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
texts.ezk.20.11: And I gave them my statutes, and showed them mine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live in them.
texts.ezk.20.12: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Jehovah that sanctifieth them.
texts.ezk.20.13: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they rejected mine ordinances, which if a man keep, he shall live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly profaned. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
texts.ezk.20.14: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.
texts.ezk.20.15: Moreover also I sware unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
texts.ezk.20.16: because they rejected mine ordinances, and walked not in my statutes, and profaned my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
texts.ezk.20.17: Nevertheless mine eye spared them, and I destroyed them not, neither did I make a full end of them in the wilderness.
texts.ezk.20.18: And I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their ordinances, nor defile yourselves with their idols.
texts.ezk.20.19: I am Jehovah your God: walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them;
texts.ezk.20.20: and hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am Jehovah your God.
texts.ezk.20.21: But the children rebelled against me; they walked not in my statutes, neither kept mine ordinances to do them, which if a man do, he shall live in them; they profaned my sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
texts.ezk.20.22: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them forth.
texts.ezk.20.23: Moreover I sware unto them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations, and disperse them through the countries;
texts.ezk.20.24: because they had not executed mine ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
texts.ezk.20.25: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances wherein they should not live;
texts.ezk.20.26: and I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through [the fire] all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.20.27: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In this moreover have your fathers blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
texts.ezk.20.28: For when I had brought them into the land, which I sware to give unto them, then they saw every high hill, and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering; there also they made their sweet savor, and they poured out there their drink-offerings.
texts.ezk.20.29: Then I said unto them, What meaneth the high place whereunto ye go? So the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
texts.ezk.20.30: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Do ye pollute yourselves after the manner of your fathers? and play ye the harlot after their abominations?
texts.ezk.20.31: and when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, do ye pollute yourselves with all your idols unto this day? and shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you;
texts.ezk.20.32: and that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, in that ye say, We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
texts.ezk.20.33: As I live, saith the Lord Jehovah, surely with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, will I be king over you:
texts.ezk.20.34: and I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out;
texts.ezk.20.35: and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there will I enter into judgment with you face to face.
texts.ezk.20.36: Like as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I enter into judgment with you, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.20.37: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant;
texts.ezk.20.38: and I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me; I will bring them forth out of the land where they sojourn, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.20.39: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Go ye, serve every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me; but my holy name shall ye no more profane with your gifts, and with your idols.
texts.ezk.20.40: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them, serve me in the land: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the first-fruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
texts.ezk.20.41: As a sweet savor will I accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.
texts.ezk.20.42: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I sware to give unto your fathers.
texts.ezk.20.43: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have polluted yourselves; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
texts.ezk.20.44: And ye shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have dealt with you for my name's sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.20.45: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.20.46: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop [thy word] toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the South;
texts.ezk.20.47: and say to the forest of the South, Hear the word of Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burnt thereby.
texts.ezk.20.48: And all flesh shall see that I, Jehovah, have kindled it; it shall not be quenched.
texts.ezk.20.49: Then said I, Ah Lord Jehovah! they say of me, Is he not a speaker of parables?
texts.ezk.21.1: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.21.2: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop [thy word] toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel;
texts.ezk.21.3: and say to the land of Israel, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
texts.ezk.21.4: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
texts.ezk.21.5: and all flesh shall know that I, Jehovah, have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath; it shall not return any more.
texts.ezk.21.6: Sigh therefore, thou son of man; with the breaking of thy loins and with bitterness shalt thou sigh before their eyes.
texts.ezk.21.7: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt say, Because of the tidings, for it cometh; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and it shall be done, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.21.8: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.21.9: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith Jehovah: Say, A sword, a sword, it is sharpened, and also furbished;
texts.ezk.21.10: it is sharpened that it may make a slaughter; it is furbished that it may be as lightning: shall we then make mirth? the rod of my son, it contemneth every tree.
texts.ezk.21.11: And it is given to be furbished, that it may be handled: the sword, it is sharpened, yea, it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
texts.ezk.21.12: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is upon my people, it is upon all the princes of Israel: they are delivered over to the sword with my people; smite therefore upon thy thigh.
texts.ezk.21.13: For there is a trial; and what if even the rod that contemneth shall be no more? saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.21.14: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thy hands together; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the deadly wounded: it is the sword of the great one that is deadly wounded, which entereth into their chambers.
texts.ezk.21.15: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied: ah! it is made as lightning, it is pointed for slaughter.
texts.ezk.21.16: Gather thee together, go to the right, set thyself in array, go to the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
texts.ezk.21.17: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
texts.ezk.21.18: The word of Jehovah came unto me again, saying,
texts.ezk.21.19: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come; they twain shall come forth out of one land: and mark out a place, mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
texts.ezk.21.20: Thou shalt appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.
texts.ezk.21.21: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he shook the arrows to and fro, he consulted the teraphim, he looked in the liver.
texts.ezk.21.22: In his right hand was the divination [for] Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, to build forts.
texts.ezk.21.23: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths unto them; but he bringeth iniquity to remembrance, that they may be taken.
texts.ezk.21.24: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
texts.ezk.21.25: And thou, O deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day is come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,
texts.ezk.21.26: thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Remove the mitre, and take off the crown; this [shall be] no more the same; exalt that which is low, and abase that which is high.
texts.ezk.21.27: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it: this also shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it [him].
texts.ezk.21.28: And thou, son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and say thou, A sword, a sword is drawn, for the slaughter it is furbished, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;
texts.ezk.21.29: while they see for thee false visions, while they divine lies unto thee, to lay thee upon the necks of the wicked that are deadly wounded, whose day is come in the time of the iniquity of the end.
texts.ezk.21.30: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy birth, will I judge thee.
texts.ezk.21.31: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee; I will blow upon thee with the fire of my wrath; and I will deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, skilful to destroy.
texts.ezk.21.32: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
texts.ezk.22.1: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.22.2: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? then cause her to know all her abominations.
texts.ezk.22.3: And thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: A city that sheddeth blood in the midst of her, that her time may come, and that maketh idols against herself to defile her!
texts.ezk.22.4: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed, and art defiled in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
texts.ezk.22.5: Those that are near, and those that are far from thee, shall mock thee, thou infamous one [and] full of tumult.
texts.ezk.22.6: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one according to his power, have been in thee to shed blood.
texts.ezk.22.7: In thee have they set light by father and mother; in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the sojourner; in thee have they wronged the fatherless and the widow.
texts.ezk.22.8: Thou hast despised my holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
texts.ezk.22.9: Slanderous men have been in thee to shed blood; and in thee they have eaten upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they have committed lewdness.
texts.ezk.22.10: In thee have they uncovered their fathers' nakedness; in thee have they humbled her that was unclean in her impurity.
texts.ezk.22.11: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbor's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.
texts.ezk.22.12: In thee have they taken bribes to shed blood; thou hast taken interest and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbors by oppression, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.22.13: Behold, therefore, I have smitten my hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
texts.ezk.22.14: Can thy heart endure, or can thy hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I, Jehovah, have spoken it, and will do it.
texts.ezk.22.15: And I will scatter thee among the nations, and disperse thee through the countries; and I will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
texts.ezk.22.16: And thou shalt be profaned in thyself, in the sight of the nations; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.22.17: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.22.18: Son of man, the house of Israel is become dross unto me: all of them are brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.
texts.ezk.22.19: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because ye are all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
texts.ezk.22.20: As they gather silver and brass and iron and lead and tin into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.
texts.ezk.22.21: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
texts.ezk.22.22: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, have poured out my wrath upon you.
texts.ezk.22.23: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.22.24: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art a land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
texts.ezk.22.25: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey: they have devoured souls; they take treasure and precious things; they have made her widows many in the midst thereof.
texts.ezk.22.26: Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
texts.ezk.22.27: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, [and] to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
texts.ezk.22.28: And her prophets have daubed for them with untempered [mortar], seeing false visions, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, when Jehovah hath not spoken.
texts.ezk.22.29: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery; yea, they have vexed the poor and needy, and have oppressed the sojourner wrongfully.
texts.ezk.22.30: And I sought for a man among them, that should build up the wall, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found none.
texts.ezk.22.31: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I brought upon their heads, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.23.1: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.23.2: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
texts.ezk.23.3: and they played the harlot in Egypt; they played the harlot in their youth; there were their breasts pressed, and there was handled the bosom of their virginity.
texts.ezk.23.4: And the names of them were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister: and they became mine, and they bare sons and daughters. And as for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.
texts.ezk.23.5: And Oholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians [her] neighbors,
texts.ezk.23.6: who were clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
texts.ezk.23.7: And she bestowed her whoredoms upon them, the choicest men of Assyria all of them; and on whomsoever she doted, with all their idols she defiled herself.
texts.ezk.23.8: Neither hath she left her whoredoms since [the days of] Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her, and they handled the bosom of her virginity; and they poured out their whoredom upon her.
texts.ezk.23.9: Wherefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
texts.ezk.23.10: These uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters; and her they slew with the sword: and she became a byword among women; for they executed judgments upon her.
texts.ezk.23.11: And her sister Oholibah saw this, yet was she more corrupt in her doting than she, and in her whoredoms which were more than the whoredoms of her sister.
texts.ezk.23.12: She doted upon the Assyrians, governors and rulers, [her] neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
texts.ezk.23.13: And I saw that she was defiled; they both took one way.
texts.ezk.23.14: And she increased her whoredoms; for she saw men portrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,
texts.ezk.23.15: girded with girdles upon their loins, with flowing turbans upon their heads, all of them princes to look upon, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their nativity.
texts.ezk.23.16: And as soon as she saw them she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
texts.ezk.23.17: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.
texts.ezk.23.18: So she uncovered her whoredoms, and uncovered her nakedness: then my soul was alienated from her, like as my soul was alienated from her sister.
texts.ezk.23.19: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, remembering the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
texts.ezk.23.20: And she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
texts.ezk.23.21: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in the handling of thy bosom by the Egyptians for the breasts of thy youth.
texts.ezk.23.22: Therefore, O Oholibah, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy soul is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side:
texts.ezk.23.23: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, [and] all the Assyrians with them; desirable young men, governors and rulers all of them, princes and men of renown, all of them riding upon horses.
texts.ezk.23.24: And they shall come against thee with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples; they shall set themselves against thee with buckler and shield and helmet round about; and I will commit the judgment unto them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
texts.ezk.23.25: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal with thee in fury; they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy residue shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
texts.ezk.23.26: They shall also strip thee of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
texts.ezk.23.27: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom [brought] from the land of Egypt; so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
texts.ezk.23.28: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy soul is alienated;
texts.ezk.23.29: and they shall deal with thee in hatred, and shall take away all thy labor, and shall leave thee naked and bare; and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be uncovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
texts.ezk.23.30: These things shall be done unto thee, for that thou hast played the harlot after the nations, and because thou art polluted with their idols.
texts.ezk.23.31: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thy hand.
texts.ezk.23.32: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup, which is deep and large; thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
texts.ezk.23.33: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
texts.ezk.23.34: Thou shalt even drink it and drain it out, and thou shalt gnaw the sherds thereof, and shalt tear thy breasts; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.23.35: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
texts.ezk.23.36: Jehovah said moreover unto me: Son of man, wilt thou judge Oholah and Oholibah? then declare unto them their abominations.
texts.ezk.23.37: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands; and with their idols have they committed adultery; and they have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass through [the fire] unto them to be devoured.
texts.ezk.23.38: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
texts.ezk.23.39: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of my house.
texts.ezk.23.40: And furthermore ye have sent for men that come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent, and, lo, they came; for whom thou didst wash thyself, paint thine eyes, and deck thyself with ornaments,
texts.ezk.23.41: and sit upon a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon thou didst set mine incense and mine oil.
texts.ezk.23.42: And the voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets upon the hands of them [twain], and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
texts.ezk.23.43: Then said I of her that was old in adulteries, Now will they play the harlot with her, and she [with them].
texts.ezk.23.44: And they went in unto her, as they go in unto a harlot: so went they in unto Oholah and unto Oholibah, the lewd women.
texts.ezk.23.45: And righteous men, they shall judge them with the judgment of adulteresses, and with the judgment of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
texts.ezk.23.46: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company against them, and will give them to be tossed to and fro and robbed.
texts.ezk.23.47: And the company shall stone them with stones, and despatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
texts.ezk.23.48: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
texts.ezk.23.49: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols; and ye shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.24.1: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth [day] of the month, the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.24.2: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, [even] of this selfsame day: the king of Babylon drew close unto Jerusalem this selfsame day.
texts.ezk.24.3: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Set on the caldron, set it on, and also pour water into it:
texts.ezk.24.4: gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
texts.ezk.24.5: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile [of wood] for the bones under [the caldron]; make it boil well; yea, let the bones thereof be boiled in the midst of it.
texts.ezk.24.6: Wherefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city, to the caldron whose rust is therein, and whose rust is not gone out of it! take out of it piece after piece; No lot is fallen upon it.
texts.ezk.24.7: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the bare rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust.
texts.ezk.24.8: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood upon the bare rock, that it should not be covered.
texts.ezk.24.9: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.
texts.ezk.24.10: Heap on the wood, make the fire hot, boil well the flesh, and make thick the broth, and let the bones be burned.
texts.ezk.24.11: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that it may be hot, and the brass thereof may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the rust of it may be consumed.
texts.ezk.24.12: She hath wearied [herself] with toil; yet her great rust goeth not forth out of her; her rust [goeth not forth] by fire.
texts.ezk.24.13: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have cleansed thee and thou wast not cleansed, thou shalt not be cleansed from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my wrath toward thee to rest.
texts.ezk.24.14: I, Jehovah, have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it: I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.24.15: Also the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.24.16: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet thou shalt neither mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
texts.ezk.24.17: Sigh, but not aloud, make no mourning for the dead; bind thy headtire upon thee, and put thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
texts.ezk.24.18: So I spake unto the people in the morning; and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
texts.ezk.24.19: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?
texts.ezk.24.20: Then I said unto them, The word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.24.21: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left behind shall fall by the sword.
texts.ezk.24.22: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
texts.ezk.24.23: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.
texts.ezk.24.24: Thus shall Ezekiel be unto you a sign; according to all that he hath done shall ye do: when this cometh, then shall ye know that I am the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.24.25: And thou, son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart, their sons and their daughters,
texts.ezk.24.26: that in that day he that escapeth shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
texts.ezk.24.27: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him that is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: so shalt thou be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.25.1: And the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.25.2: Son of man, set thy face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them:
texts.ezk.25.3: and say unto the children of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was made desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity:
texts.ezk.25.4: therefore, behold, I will deliver thee to the children of the east for a possession, and they shall set their encampments in thee, and make their dwellings in thee; they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
texts.ezk.25.5: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the children of Ammon a couching-place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.25.6: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast clapped thy hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the despite of thy soul against the land of Israel;
texts.ezk.25.7: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the nations; and I will cut thee off from the peoples, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.25.8: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the nations;
texts.ezk.25.9: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,
texts.ezk.25.10: unto the children of the east, [to go] against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.
texts.ezk.25.11: and I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.25.12: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
texts.ezk.25.13: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, I will stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; even unto Dedan shall they fall by the sword.
texts.ezk.25.14: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel; and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my wrath; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.25.15: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with despite of soul to destroy with perpetual enmity;
texts.ezk.25.16: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
texts.ezk.25.17: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with wrathful rebukes; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
texts.ezk.26.1: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.26.2: Son of man, because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken [that was] the gate of the peoples; she is turned unto me; I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste:
texts.ezk.26.3: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I am against thee, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth its waves to come up.
texts.ezk.26.4: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.
texts.ezk.26.5: She shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah; and she shall become a spoil to the nations.
texts.ezk.26.6: And her daughters that are in the field shall be slain with the sword: and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
texts.ezk.26.7: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and a company, and much people.
texts.ezk.26.8: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field; and he shall make forts against thee, and cast up a mound against thee, and raise up the buckler against thee.
texts.ezk.26.9: And he shall set his battering engines against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
texts.ezk.26.10: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
texts.ezk.26.11: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets; he shall slay thy people with the sword; and the pillars of thy strength shall go down to the ground.
texts.ezk.26.12: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise; and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses; and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the waters.
texts.ezk.26.13: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
texts.ezk.26.14: And I will make thee a bare rock; thou shalt be a place for the spreading of nets; thou shalt be built no more: for I Jehovah have spoken it, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.26.15: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
texts.ezk.26.16: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble every moment, and be astonished at thee.
texts.ezk.26.17: And they shall take up a lamentation over thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, that was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, that caused their terror to be on all that dwelt there!
texts.ezk.26.18: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be dismayed at thy departure.
texts.ezk.26.19: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and the great waters shall cover thee;
texts.ezk.26.20: then will I bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make thee to dwell in the nether parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living:
texts.ezk.26.21: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt no more have any being; though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.ezk.27.1: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,
texts.ezk.27.2: And thou, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
texts.ezk.27.3: and say unto Tyre, O thou that dwellest at the entry of the sea, that art the merchant of the peoples unto many isles, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Thou, O Tyre, hast said, I am perfect in beauty.
texts.ezk.27.4: Thy borders are in the heart of the seas; thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
texts.ezk.27.5: They have made all thy planks of fir-trees from Senir; they have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for thee.
texts.ezk.27.6: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; they have made thy benches of ivory inlaid in boxwood, from the isles of Kittim.
texts.ezk.27.7: Of fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was thy sail, that it might be to thee for an ensign; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was thine awning.
texts.ezk.27.8: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were thy rowers: thy wise men, O Tyre, were in thee, they were thy pilots.
texts.ezk.27.9: The old men of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to deal in thy merchandise.
texts.ezk.27.10: Persia and Lud and Put were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
texts.ezk.27.11: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and valorous men were in thy towers; they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have perfected thy beauty.
texts.ezk.27.12: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded for thy wares.
texts.ezk.27.13: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy traffickers; they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass for thy merchandise.
texts.ezk.27.14: They of the house of Togarmah traded for thy wares with horses and war-horses and mules.
